headline: Senate muscle-flexes student-athlete protections as amendments fly on the college sports bill!

senate.lastSessionSummary: Senate convened at 10 a.m. on Wednesday and spent the day considering amendments to S. 4668, the Protect College Sports Act, with multiple procedural motions and amendments from Senator Thune filed. The chamber passed six bills including the Romance Scam Prevention Act and Secure Space Act, and confirmed Angela Veronica Colmenero as United States District Judge for the Southern District of Texas by a 50-47 vote. Senate adjourned at 7:28 p.m. as a mark of respect to the memory of former Senator Jon Kyl.
